description: Late letter in Hebrew addressed to "my father" whose name is lost to damage but features a wide variety of rabbinic honorifics. The first line features some exquisite calligraphy that may comprise a gematria date given that the first three letters are שנת. Requires further examination.
description_he: מכתב מאוחר בעברית. קטע. דרוש בדיקה.
